config.source_scope: Fictional original depot records for four physical vehicles; complete consecutive depot population and all declared source families.
config.returned_scope: Fictional receiving projection of the same exact source records, documents and historical identities.
config.authority_notes: Every name, vehicle, event, document and monetary amount in this course is authored. Real release authority remains with the actual operator.

fleet.selection_notes: Every physical vehicle present during the declared depot window is included; V4 unknown readiness remains in the denominator.
fleet.measurement_notes: Paired authored active-person observations include all eight phases, increased safety-review work and exact signed change; no downtime-to-cash inference.
